svg.title: DINOIDOL architecture
svg.desc: Conceptual DINO and MaskDINO-style frame segmentation with IDOL temporal association. Encoded features supply reference boxes, decoder memory, and pixel features. Training-only denoising queries enter the decoder separately. Class, box, mask, and re-identification predictions are associated into persistent video tracks.
svg.text: From video frames to tracked instruments
DINO / MaskDINO-style frame segmentation with IDOL temporal association
Includes feature fusion for the mask branch.
Track memory is carried forward and updated for each incoming frame.
Conceptual integration based on the supplied schematic; repository implementation is not verified.
N / M, feature scales, query initialization and denoising settings depend on configuration.
